name: Cloudflare

onboarding.notes: The template must first be merged into the Templates repository, then requested by email with: the template links, the FQDNs of the syncPubKeyDomain TXT records, a logo (SVG preferred), the default proxy status for A, AAAA and CNAME records, and optionally a Cloudflare account ID to test the template before it is published. syncBlock, if present, must be false. Templates with APEXCNAME fail onboarding. Lint with dc-template-linter -cloudflare. Template updates are picked up automatically (expected within eight hours); opting out is possible.

notes: The signature (sig) is required and must be the last query parameter. state and serviceName in the apply URL are ignored. Ignored template properties: syncBlock, shared, sharedServiceName, syncRedirectDomain, multiInstance, warnPhishing, hostRequired; ignored record properties: essential, txtConflictMatchingMode, txtConflictMatchingPrefix (a template TXT record only conflicts with an identical TXT record, so SPF must use SPFM). REDIR301/REDIR302 become zone bulk redirect rules and replace existing bulk redirects. A CNAME on the apex is flattened.
